youtube.title: Why your 1TB drive only shows 931GB 🤔 #shorts
youtube.description:
Nothing is missing – it’s math. Drive makers count 1 TB = 1,000,000,000,000 bytes. Windows divides by 1024 three times → 931 “GB” (really GiB). A Mac counts in thousands and shows the full 1 TB.

More free tools: https://slimbitapps.github.io/
